description: This file defines the `BuzzLikeOnShareDecorator` class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the 'Decorators' entity namespace. The class provides methods to set employee and share references, and to retrieve formatted dates related to 'like' actions on shared buzz posts, by decorating the `BuzzLikeOnShare` entity.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnShareDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for `BuzzLikeOnShare` that provides methods to set references to employee and share entities, and to retrieve formatted 'liked at' date and time.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a `BuzzLikeOnShare` entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee relation in the `BuzzLikeOnShare` entity based on an employee number.

methods.name: setShareByShareId
methods.description: Sets the share relation in the `BuzzLikeOnShare` entity based on the share ID.

methods.name: getLikedAtDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the like was registered, formatted as a string.

methods.name: getLikedAtTime
methods.description: Returns the time when the like was registered, formatted as a string.
